Qualitative Analysis: You started the introduction well by stating your name and the role you are applying for. This gives a clear understanding to the interviewer
You demonstrated strong knowledge in the field of AI and provided specifics about your projects on LLM, CNN, PCI shift. This showcases your technical expertise which is a positive attribute
You comfortably shared about your personal interests, hobbies and even a minor weakness which shows your openness and ability to connect on a personal level.
Quantitative Analysis: You asked relevant and thoughtful question about the company's upcoming product, but it would be more beneficial to also ask about the role you are applying for, or the team you will be joining
Although you mentioned your projects, you didn't explain the impact of your work. Going forward, elaborate on the outcomes/results of your project
While you discussed your weakness honestly, it was unrelated to your professional skills. Employers are more interested in understanding any professional areas of improvement
You didn't clearly articulate your strengths in relation to the role you're applying for. It's important to discuss how your strengths align with the job requirements
You could engage the interviewer by asking their perspective or experience in the company. It shows your interest in understanding the workplace culture.
